about: Stills of the Lens & Distort pages (docs/Features/effects/<id>.md): compare pairs and preset strips. Make them with node scripts/docs-media.mjs <effect id>.

pairs.name: lens-correction
pairs.alt: The rainy night street as a strong wide-angle lens bends it, original left and with Lens Correction right: on the left the shop fronts at both edges bow outward like a barrel; on the right they stand straight and upright, the street runs straight to the vanishing point and the picture is slightly enlarged
pairs.caption: Left: a shot from a strong wide-angle lens. Right: Distortion −28, Scale 120 (the Action Cam preset).
